missing.why: Mega Inferno Bomb is very long range but not global; not missing.
Weaver's Wall is long but limited; not missing.
Global ult (Cannon Barrage) but melee by base range; correctly excluded, expect wrong guesses.
Global shield ult but melee; correctly excluded.

disputable.why: Base range 325 makes her ranged, but players see her as a melee-ish skirmisher; R only affects Drowsy enemies, though anywhere on the map.
Golden Eclipse hits all Overwhelmed enemies anywhere; players may not consider it a 'global ult'.
Whirling Death travels the full map; widely known, but some argue it's not 'global' in the TF/Karthus sense.

wording.why: 'global' is fuzzy for long-range ults (Ziggs, Jhin) versus conditional map-wide ones (Lillia, Mel).
wording.suggestion: Name a ranged champion whose ultimate can reach anywhere on the map

fun.why: Jinx, Ezreal, Karthus are easy; Senna, Draven, Lillia, Mel are satisfying finds. Small set but most players can name a few.

champion:Jinx.why: Super Mega Death Rocket is the iconic global snipe.

champion:Karthus.why: Requiem is the textbook global ult.

champion:Draven.why: Whirling Death forgotten next to the above.

champion:Senna.why: Dawning Shadow is global but less remembered.

champion:Lillia.why: Conditional, rarely thought of as global.

gemCandidates.why: Dawning Shadow crosses the map; a clear 'of course' on reveal.
Whirling Death is global and players kick themselves for missing it.
Lilting Lullaby works map-wide on Drowsy targets; fun fact, a few players get it.
